transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for being here. As we all know, Grandma's house is empty now but her upright piano is still there, and we want to make sure it stays in the family and actually gets played rather than just sitting unused. I've got the house key, so I'll be the one making the final call on where it goes — but I want to hear from each of you first before I decide. So for this check-in, I'd like to ask everyone: what can you realistically take on when it comes to housing or caring for the piano, and what would make a plan workable for you? That includes things like space, logistics, cost, and whether you'd be open to having relatives visit to play it by arrangement. Take it one at a time — whoever wants to go first, jump in.
